kind: saved-input assembly (accepted I032 geometry plus frozen partition design); not a calculator output

frame.axes: +z upward, vehicle frame of the saved I032 design
frame.hull: circular midbody R 27.5 m, floor -27.5 m (I017 record); containment fit remains UNKNOWN (withdrawn I032 witness not reused)

stock.head_model: oblate (ellipsoidal) cap, same wall offset as shell (inner depth 0.297 m, inner equatorial radius = ID/2)

divider.plate: 6 mm circular 5083-class plate cut to actual inner barrel diameter
divider.stiffeners: 8 equally spaced radial T on underside: 100 mm deep x 6 mm web, 60 x 6 mm flange, from paid 200 mm OD central sump collar to ring; actual net lengths/overlaps/voids charged
divider.welds: 6 mm continuous fillet seams at divider/ring boundaries, stiffener webs, collar intersections; no ideal rigid-joint credit
divider.compartments: bottom fresh reserve + upper switchable service

sump.per_upper: 350 mm OD x 6 mm wall cylindrical cup, 100 mm below divider, 6 mm floor, DN300 service-drain throat; displaces reserve capacity

uppers.baffles: the two original flow-through baffles repartitioned into the SERVICE chamber at z=-19.350 and -18.350 m; 3 mm plate, 8 x 150 mm holes each; reserve has no separate full-width baffle; anti-slosh adequacy UNKNOWN

lowers.compartments: retained freshwater chamber, original two baffles/ports retained

freeboard_rules.reserve: 60 mm vertical gas/freeboard clearance measured below the divider underside
freeboard_rules.service: 60 mm below the actual inner top boundary, further limited by vent/overflow level
freeboard_rules.lower: 60 mm below the actual inner top boundary, further limited by vent/overflow level
freeboard_rules.max_level: most restrictive surface; one world-z datum for head/barrel/divider/port/liquid boundaries

water.species: delivered freshwater and retained scoop countermass carried as separate ledgers; never mixed in a chamber
water.scoop_density_note: scoop water assumed 1.0 t/m3 lake water (declared assumption)

relocation.explicit: the 0.9 t formerly allocated 0.45 t per lower tank moves upstairs; not discarded, no unchanged-CG claim; lower tanks freshwater-only during D2

mission.concurrent: scoop receipt and D2 delivery concurrent in the SAME 45-minute window, both pairs
mission.D1_timing: inherited I017/I032 timing and mismatch constraints; 25 t drained from each upper service chamber; no reserve transfer before/during D1
mission.switch_event: close both service delivery isolators, close positive blank, isolate/bleed interspace, confirm service drained, enable scoop fill; actuation/drainage/contamination/duration UNKNOWN unless bounded
mission.no_relaxation: no tank resizing, water/payload relaxation, nine-minute D2 substitution, sequential-pair shortcut or extra flight window

flow_rates_nominal_per_pair_kg_s.internal_split: reserve:lower = 1:4 relative to that pair's outgoing command

skew_cases.cases: exactly eight: leading pair A or B; eps = +0.05 or -0.05; delta = 0 or 2 s
skew_cases.law: leading pair freshwater commands x (1+eps), scoop x (1-eps); lagging pair starts delta later with opposite rate errors; internal fresh transfer and lower draw retain the 1:4 split relative to that pair's outgoing command
skew_cases.clamp: clamp inventory by the finite source/command target only, NEVER by capacity to hide overflow
skew_cases.breakpoints: include start + T/(1+/-eps) symbolically when within 0..T, all nominal checkpoints and T
skew_cases.unfinished: report unfinished delivery/receipt at T as a timing FAIL, not a permitted extension
skew_cases.boundary_cases: D1 one-upper-service-empty/other-full; each switch-not-confirmed state; no perfect-simultaneity assumption
skew_cases.unknown: extra transient/closed-loop recovery; no optimisation or continuous sweep

service_drain_DN300.valves: 2 x DN300 isolation in series, 70 kg each declared complete-body with actuator, 400 mm face-to-face
service_drain_DN300.blank: 10 kg removable positive blank between them
service_drain_DN300.bleed: 5 kg interspace bleed valve to service reset drain
service_drain_DN300.door_reuse: old D1 door hardware only with exact retained mass/duty; valves do not certify inherited fast-drop timing
